c74object.name: evi_core.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_core.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a codebox or in another .genexpr file via the "require()" command.
By declaring require("evi_core.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in the evi_core.genexpr file.
The evi_core.genexpr file also requires: evi_approx.genexpr
evi_utilities.genexpr
evi_tanh.genexpr
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_cossin.genexpr
evi_trig.genexpr
evi_pade.genexpr
evi_fastskew.genexpr
evi_interp.genexpr
